description: Edit Power BI Project (PBIP) queries in VS Code: Power Query M linting, data preview, and safe write-back to TMDL. Works with the official Power Query / M Language extension.
welcome.noFolder:
Open the folder of a Power BI Project (.pbip) to edit its Power Query M with linting, data preview and safe write-back.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
Only have a .pbix? You can still read its queries.
[Open Queries from PBIX](command:mlens.extractPbixQueries)
welcome.noProject:
No Power BI Project or Power Query files in this folder.
In Power BI Desktop, use File > Save as > Power BI Project (.pbip), then open that folder here.
[Open Queries from PBIX](command:mlens.extractPbixQueries)
[Learn about Power BI Projects](https://learn.microsoft.com/power-bi/developer/projects/projects-overview)
welcome.noSources: No data sources found in .pq or .m files yet.
welcome.noDependencies: No query references another query yet.
config.lint.enabled: Check Power Query files with the M Lens rules.
config.lint.unusedStep: Severity for steps that are declared but never used.
config.lint.tableBuffer: Severity for Table.Buffer, List.Buffer and Binary.Buffer, which load data into memory and stop query folding.
config.lint.hardcodedPath: Severity for local or network file paths written in the query (parameters are not flagged).
config.lint.genericStepName: Severity for step names generated by the Power Query editor, such as "Custom1" or "Tipo Alterado2".
config.lint.sensitiveLiteral: Severity for text that looks like a password, token or API key.
config.lint.localhostSource: Severity for sources that point to localhost or 127.0.0.1.
config.lint.webContentsOptions: Severity for Web.Contents calls with a hardcoded query string instead of the RelativePath and Query options.
config.lint.removeColumnsRisk: Severity for Table.RemoveColumns where Table.SelectColumns would be more explicit.
config.files.lintMFiles: Treat .m files as Power Query in checks and reports. Turn off if your .m files are MATLAB or Objective-C.
config.preview.pqTestPath: Full path to PQTest.exe. Leave empty to find it in the Power Query SDK extension.
config.preview.maxRows: Maximum number of rows shown in the data preview.
config.preview.injectCredentials: Make API credentials available to previews through MLens_GetCredential("Name").
